items.title: MSCI confirms Strategy’s removal from indexes at end of November
items.snippet: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi are marked for deletion in MSCI’s final list, with changes taking effect after the Nov. 30 close.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
